title: Nebula aimbot
features:
Nebula Aimbot


Features:
- Raycast visibility check (only aims at what you can actually see)
- Smart team detection with per-team toggles (auto-detects teams)
- Smooth aimbot with adjustable smoothing (1-20)
- Custom FOV circle with color and transparency options
- Hit chance control (1-100%) for realistic accuracy
- Health check - ignores dead players
- Max distance slider (100-1000 studs)
- Target bone selection: Head, UpperTorso, or HumanoidRootPart
- Activation modes: Hold or Toggle
- Custom keybinds (left click, right click, middle click)
- Emergency disable with END key

Controls:
INSERT - Open/close the  menu
END - Emergency disable (instantly stops the aimbot)
Right click (default) - Hold to aim (or toggle if you switch modes)

How to use:
1. Run the script in your executor
2. Press INSERT to open the menu
3. Configure your settings (smoothing, FOV, keybinds, team filter, etc.)
4. Enable Team Check if you want to filter enemies by team
5. Hold your aim key (default right click) and watch it lock on

Works best in first-person shooters where mousemoverel is supported. The script uses raycasting for visibility checks and filters out dead or invalid targets automatically.

Note: its free and always will be free, it has minimal bugs but this is my first script ever.
